description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'FormatWithPurgeStringTest' for testing the 'FormatWithPurgeString' class from the OrangeHRM maintenance purge strategy module. It sets up an instance of the class and verifies that the 'getFormattedValue' method returns 'Purged' for specific inputs.

classes.name: FormatWithPurgeStringTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test case for the FormatWithPurgeString class.

methods.name: setUp

methods.description: Tests that 'getFormattedValue' returns 'Purged' for the input 'First Name' and null.
